units.rawText: There are always flowers in bloom at the Oasis... Ah, sorry. I got lost staring at the flowers.

units.rawText: I love flowers. Even in a war-torn sector like Cyclopes, they still bloom stubbornly in the cracks.

units.rawText: I believe that someday Cyclopes will be surrounded by blooming flowers just like the Oasis. When that day comes, please be sure to visit Cyclopes, Professor.
